metadata.name: P5R Menu Music (Soundtrack Menu)
metadata.description:
Persona 5 Royal music for the main menu of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+. Menu-only: every in-run track keeps the game's default audio.
Requires the Soundtrack Menu mod (by Nato Potato) with Repentogon. After enabling this mod, start a run once, then open Mod Config Menu > Soundtrack > Main Menu and pick "P5R".
Music by Shoji Meguro / Atlus. This is a fan mod; no ownership of the music is claimed.
